questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence.

A) She has lived in London since 2010, and she still lives there.
B) She has lived in London since 2010, but she doesn't live there anymore.
C) She has lived in London since 2010, so she knows the city well.
D) She has lived in London since 2010, or she moved there last year.
options: She has lived in London since 2010, and she still lives there.
She has lived in London since 2010, but she doesn't live there anymore.
She has lived in London since 2010, so she knows the city well.
She has lived in London since 2010, or she moved there last year.
questions.answer: She has lived in London since 2010, and she still lives there.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?

A) I have seen that film last week.
B) I have seen that film for three times.
C) I have seen that film already.
D) I have seen that film yesterday.
options: I have seen that film last week.
I have seen that film for three times.
I have seen that film already.
I have seen that film yesterday.
questions.answer: I have seen that film already.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb.

If I _____ more time, I would travel around the world.

A) have
B) had
C) will have
D) would have
options: have
had
will have
would have

questions.question:
Which option correctly completes the sentence?

By the time she finishes university, she _____ five years older.

A) will be
B) has been
C) would be
D) was being
options: will be
has been
would be
was being

questions.question:
Choose the correct comparative form.

This book is _____ interesting than the one we read last week.

A) more
B) much
C) many
D) most
options: more
much
many
most

questions.question:
Select the correct sentence.

A) If it rains, the match will be cancelled.
B) If it rains, the match will be cancelling.
C) If it rains, the match will be cancelled.
D) If it rains, the match will be to be cancelled.
options: If it rains, the match will be cancelled.
If it rains, the match will be cancelling.
If it rains, the match will be cancelled.
If it rains, the match will be to be cancelled.
questions.answer: If it rains, the match will be cancelled.

questions.question:
Which modal verb is used to give a strong suggestion?

A) You should go to the cinema.
B) You might go to the cinema.
C) You must go to the cinema.
D) You could go to the cinema.
options: You should go to the cinema.
You might go to the cinema.
You must go to the cinema.
You could go to the cinema.
questions.answer: You should go to the cinema.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct infinitive or gerund.

After _____ the interview, she realised she had made a mistake.

A) finishing
B) finished
C) to finish
D) to finished
options: finishing
finished
to finish
to finished

questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence.

A) It is necessary that everyone speaks quietly.
B) It is necessary that everyone speak quietly.
C) It is necessary that everyone spoke quietly.
D) It is necessary that everyone has spoken quietly.
options: It is necessary that everyone speaks quietly.
It is necessary that everyone speak quietly.
It is necessary that everyone spoke quietly.
It is necessary that everyone has spoken quietly.
questions.answer: It is necessary that everyone speak quietly.

questions.question:
Which word best completes the sentence?

Learning English _____ challenging but very rewarding.

A) is
B) are
C) was
D) were
options: is
are
was
were
